name: recovery
description: What S3 does with a blocked unit, by normalized cause and occurrence. The Nth failure of a cause on one unit takes the Nth action; the last action repeats. Retry and repair spend attempts and become escalate when the unit's attempt ceiling is reached. One cause the router can classify has no rule here, on purpose: `context-degradation`, an attempt that ended without a report after the behavioral canary fell silent (#133), whose `retry` is a fresh session on the degraded attempt's ledger. A cause that rests on an advisory finding is routed only under a declared rule, so here such an attempt is routed as `no-report` and the finding is evidence on the decision. The reason is the first live report (evals/reports/drift-live-2026-11-08.json): the canary fell silent in 12 of 18 treatment units, each closed on the attempt in which it fell silent, and no attempt was refused or ended without a report, so on the one model observed the silence has not preceded a failure and does not tell a degraded attempt from one about to close. A rule waits on a live run that shows lead time.
